text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of postgraduate school 5. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 6.Study plan Including study purpose, research interest and research plan in brief. 7.English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. 8.Financial support statement A certificate from the financial guarantor of the applicant. 9.Health certificate Required during application.Photocopy of notarized foreigner physical examination record (for durations of study over 6 months)
